name: Fishing Rods
description: Every rod, what it is good at and where it comes from.

pages.title: Fishing Rods
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Craft Stone, then upgrade at a **Smithing Table** with string as the template: iron, gold, amethyst, diamond.
- Better rods last longer and hold more **bait**.
- A **Netherite** or **Blazing** rod fishes in lava.
- Six special rods are found, not made.

Every rod takes the usual fishing enchantments (Lure, Luck of the Sea, Unbreaking, Mending) and is repaired with string on an anvil. A rod that breaks gives back its line, bobber and hook.\
\
Bait slots: how many different baits the rod holds at once (see [#](2E5AAC)[Bait](entry://fishing/bait)[#]()).

pages.title: Fishing Rod
pages.text: 3 sticks, 2 string. 32 uses, 1 bait slot. Old rods from before Tide are these, enchantments kept.

pages.title: Stone Fishing Rod
pages.text: Cobblestone and string. 48 uses, 1 bait slot. The usual base to smith from.

pages.title: Iron Fishing Rod
pages.text: Smith a plain or stone rod with an iron ingot. 64 uses, 1 bait slot.

pages.title: Golden Fishing Rod
pages.text: Smith with a gold ingot. 36 uses, 2 bait slots, +1 luck.

pages.title: Crystal Fishing Rod
pages.text: Smith with an amethyst shard. 80 uses, 2 bait slots, and it chimes when a fish bites.

pages.title: Diamond Fishing Rod
pages.text: Smith with a diamond. 128 uses, 2 bait slots, extra experience with every catch.

pages.title: Netherite Fishing Rod
pages.text: Diamond rod + netherite ingot + Netherite Upgrade. 512 uses, 2 bait slots, fireproof, **fishes in lava**.

**Found, not made** (256 uses each):

- **Rod of Resonance**: ancient city chests. 3 slots; on a bite it tells you what is hooked.
- **Prismarine Fishing Rod**: sometimes dropped by Elder Guardians. 3 slots; +1 speed and +1 luck in rain.

- **Suncatcher**: a rare catch in plains. 6 slots; +1 luck in sunshine.
- **Rod of the Hero**: an expert Fisherman villager sells it for 15 emeralds. 4 slots; an extra village item with every catch.
- **Blazing Fishing Rod**: nether fortress chests. 4 slots, fishes in lava, and finds Nether lava fish anywhere.

- **Beeline**: sometimes found when you harvest honeycomb from a hive. 5 slots.
- **Midas Fishing Rod**: smith a golden rod with a **Midas Fish**. 3 slots, +1 luck and a bonus gold item with every catch.\
\
Owning all 14 rods earns **Hooked on Variety**.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Two other rods keep the old cast-and-wait fishing with no timing game: **Alloyed**'s Steel Fishing Rod (see [#](2E5AAC)[Alloyed](entry://industry/alloyed)[#]()) and any Aquaculture rod you already own. Hybrid Aquatic hooks in the off hand work with both.
